# Third-party files in the panel

| Files | What | License |
|---|---|---|
| `../tailwindcss-browser-4.1.18.js` | Tailwind CSS 4.1.18, browser build | MIT — `tailwindcss-MIT.txt` |
| `../fonts/Geist-*.woff2`, `../fonts/GeistMono-*.woff2` | Geist and Geist Mono (Vercel) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — `Geist-OFL.txt` |
| `../fonts/PressStart2P-*.woff2` | Press Start 2P (CodeMan38) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — `PressStart2P-OFL.txt` |

The font files are the Google Fonts web subsets, unchanged (copied so the panel works offline). Everything else in the panel is Teamly's own.
